deviations.description: Two A1 scripts were sent to an AgentHub EnvBench evaluator even though the preregistered primary independent Official queue is Spark.

observed_nonprimary_results.diagnostic: Bootstrap failed because pkg_resources was unavailable during Pretalx compilemessages.
The nonprimary AgentHub evaluator completed before cancellation took effect.

deviations.analysis_disposition: Exclude both AgentHub outcomes from all primary and secondary treatment estimates. Retain them only as disclosed diagnostics.
deviations.recovery: Run the exact submitted A1 script for each affected run through the preregistered Spark independent Official queue and use only that result.
deviations.protocol_effect: No scoring rule or experimental object changed. No refreeze, new safeguard, contract, or gate is required.
